scams.name: The Friendship Bracelet Trap
scams.avoidance: Keep hands in pockets and walk with purpose near tourist sights Simply say 'no grazie' firmly and keep moving If a bracelet gets put on you, take it off immediately and drop it — they usually won't chase
scams.location: Ponte Vecchio, Piazza del Duomo, tourist streets

scams.name: Street Painting Trap
scams.avoidance: Watch your step carefully near outdoor art displays Don't engage or apologize — just walk away Real licensed vendors don't lay artwork on the ground in foot traffic
scams.location: Outside Uffizi Gallery, Piazza della Signoria

scams.name: Pickpocket Mob
scams.avoidance: Use a money belt or keep valuables in front pockets Never put your phone in your back pocket near tourist sights Be extra alert on bus lines 1 and 7 — popular pickpocket routes
scams.location: Crowded tourist areas, ATAF buses, markets

scams.name: Clipboard Petition Scam
scams.avoidance: Never stop walking to sign anything from strangers Say 'no' without breaking stride Keep your bag in front of you whenever you're stopped
scams.location: Near major monuments, Piazza del Duomo

scams.name: Tourist Menu Price Trap
scams.avoidance: Check for 'coperto' (cover charge) on the menu before sitting Explicitly refuse bread and starters if you didn't order them Walk one or two streets away from major sights for better-priced, less scammy restaurants
scams.location: Restaurants near Piazza della Repubblica, Uffizi, Duomo

scams.name: Fake Rose Gift Ambush
scams.avoidance: Don't accept anything from street vendors without asking the price first Hand it back immediately before they walk away A firm 'non voglio' (I don't want it) usually works
